newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns Rauma euro-commercial programme A-2.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns Rauma euro-commercial programme A-2.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Thursday it assigned an A-2 rating to Finnish company Rauma Oy's $100 million Euro-commercial paper programme.
In addition, S&P affirmed engineering group Rauma's BBB+ long-term and A-2 short-term issuer credit ratings, the agency said in a statement, adding that the outlook was stable.
"The ratings reflect the Rauma Group's diverse earnings and cash flow base, its strong world market position in core businesses and sound financial profile and policies," S&P said.

"Demand is cyclical but the swings are mitigated by Rauma's worldwide presence -- North America, Western Europe, and the rest of the world roughly account for one-third each of sales," the agency said.
To balance the operating risk, S&P said it expected Rauma to maintain a conservative financial profile.
